name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: A Government of India initiative intended to facilitate bank loans for eligible SC/ST entrepreneurs and women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefit: Bank loan support for eligible greenfield enterprises.

eligibility.notes: Eligibility, loan terms and conditions should be verified from the official Stand-Up India portal.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: PMEGP is a credit-linked scheme aimed at generating employment opportunities through creation of new micro enterprises in rural and urban areas.
benefit: Credit-linked financial assistance and margin money subsidy for eligible new micro enterprises.

eligibility.notes: Exact project limits, subsidy rates and eligibility conditions should be verified on the official PMEGP portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides institutional credit support to eligible micro enterprises through participating lending institutions.
benefit: Access to institutional credit for eligible micro and small business activities.

eligibility.notes: Loan category, amount, interest rate and repayment terms depend on the applicable lender and current scheme guidelines.

name: National SC-ST Hub
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: The National SC-ST Hub supports SC/ST owned Micro and Small Enterprises through capacity building, market access, procurement support and other interventions.
benefit: Support for capacity building, market access and participation in government procurement opportunities.

eligibility.notes: Specific eligibility and available interventions should be checked with the National SC-ST Hub / MSME portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises
description: PMFME supports the formalisation and strengthening of micro food processing enterprises and provides support through financial assistance, capacity building and related interventions.
benefit: Support for formalisation, upgrading, capacity building and strengthening of micro food processing enterprises.

eligibility.notes: Current component-wise eligibility and assistance should be verified on the official PMFME portal.

name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises
description: The Credit Guarantee Scheme facilitates access to institutional credit for eligible micro and small enterprises by providing credit guarantee support through the applicable framework.
benefit: Credit guarantee support that can help eligible MSEs access institutional finance.

eligibility.notes: Guarantee coverage, eligible facilities, fees and other conditions should be verified from the official CGTMSE portal.

name: Startup India
ministry: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
description: Startup India is a Government of India initiative supporting the startup ecosystem through recognition, funding-related initiatives, mentorship, intellectual property support and other startup-focused programs.
benefit: Access to startup ecosystem initiatives including DPIIT recognition, easier compliance, IPR facilitation and eligible benefits.

eligibility.notes: DPIIT recognition has specific current criteria relating to entity type, age, turnover and innovation/scalability. Verify current criteria on Startup India.

name: Women Entrepreneurship Support
description: Women entrepreneurs can access multiple government and institutional programmes designed to improve access to finance, entrepreneurship development, skills, markets and business support.
benefit: Access to relevant government entrepreneurship, finance and business-support programmes for eligible women entrepreneurs.

eligibility.notes: This entry is a discovery category rather than a single standalone central scheme. Users should verify the exact applicable programme and eligibility before applying.
